$schema-note: Quality ratchet (SUI-FEATURE-128, GL-CODE-002). Finding count per tool of the gate phases `hygiene` and `knip`; scripts/hygiene.ts turns the phase red when a measured count rises above its entry. A count may only fall, except a raise the lead books in the change itself (GL-CODE-021): the entry set to the gate's measured count, the cause named in the commit and in a CHANGELOG line. Security counts (Semgrep, gitleaks, Trivy, eslint.security) are never raised that way: the change fixes the finding, or the owner decides. Values come from `npm run hygiene:inventory` on main or such a raise, and change only with `node_modules/.bin/spec-sync measure set|remove`. Size lines are not counts: they live in size-limit-lines.json, and `size-limit.over-maximum` counts the entries above their maximum.
